To support this mission, the Government requires a modern software solution that serves as a relational database and analysis toolset. This toolset is essential for the iSMART (interoperable Systems Management and Requirements Transformation) process and is used to populate, edit, analyze, and manage TDL message data, platform implementations, and interoperability evaluations. 2.0 SCOPE The Contractor shall provide a commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software solution, including all necessary licenses, updates, training, and technical support. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. Kostnader ved utarbeidelse av tilbud Eventuelle kostnader leverandøren har ved utarbeidelse av tilbudet dekkes av leverandøren selv. Oppdragsgiver refunderer ikke kostnader knyttet til utarbeidelse eller innlevering av tilbud. Deltilbud Anskaffelsen er ikke delt i delkontrakter. Det er ikke adgang til deltilbud. Alternative tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere alternative tilbud. Parallelle tilbud Side 4 av 21 Det er ikke tillatt å levere parallelle tilbud. Hver leverandør kan ha ett gjeldende tilbud per delkontrakt. Forretningshemmeligheter og sladding Ved innlevering skal leverandøren ta stilling til om opplysninger i tilbudet utgjør forretningshemmeligheter, merke disse og levere en sladdet versjon der det er påkrevd. Oppdragsgiver behandler innsynsbegjæringer etter offentleglova og forvaltningsloven. Στον έλεγχο θα πρέπει να συμπεριλαμβάνεται και η επικοινωνία μεταξύ των διαφόρων εμπλεκομένων υποσυστημάτων, τόσο εντός όσο και εκτός SAP (integration testing) αλλά και η ανταπόκριση του συστήματος ( system response time) . public health through development of data and knowledge that are translatable, predictive, and timely. The Mechanistic Toxicology Branch (MTB) within the DTT conducts laboratory research to identify human health hazards and understand environmental toxicity through hybrid basic and applied science approaches that include development of new approach methods (NAMs) for toxicology research. The MTB is pioneering innovative toxicology research with advanced cell systems such as human tissue chips and 3D organoid models to understand the adverse effects of chemicals, drugs, and natural products and develop innovative solutions for translational toxicology research. 2) Objectives: The MTB seeks to solve ongoing challenges in the scalable generation of 3D human organoid/spheroid models by exploring the potential of microencapsulation technology to bioengineer human tissue models that better reflect human physiology for translational toxicology research. A Fluigent Microencapsulation System has been identified as uniquely suited for our exploratory research needs to model toxicity-induced liver fibrosis with 3D microtissue models. A Fluigent Microencapsulation System has been identified as uniquely suited for our exploratory research needs to model toxicity-induced liver fibrosis with 3D microtissue models.
